programme.title: 10 Ways Your House Could Kill You
programme.desc: I tested deadly situations that could happen right inside your own house to see just how dangerous everyday home life can actually be.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Weapons From Video Games
programme.desc: I tested deadly video game weapons in real life to see if they're actually as effective as they are in the games they come from.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Home Security Systems
programme.desc: I tested extreme home security devices, including electric door mats, a face-tracking airsoft turret, and a rapid fogging system, to see if they truly protect your home or are just scams.

programme.title: I Tried Escaping Impossible Deaths
programme.desc: I put myself into different deadly situations to see if I could escape in time, like a house fire, quicksand, being locked in a freezer, a straitjacket, a car trunk, and even the back of a police car.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Island Survival Myths
programme.desc: I tested popular island survival myths to see which ones would actually help you survive and which ones would get you killed.

programme.title: I Tested Movie Deaths In Real Life (again)
programme.desc: I tested movie deaths from popular films in real life again, including a real-life tree cutting scene, to see how accurate they actually are.

programme.title: 10 Sports You Didn't Know Could Kill You (again)
programme.desc: I teamed up with athletes again to showcase dangerous sports impacts and just how much damage they can actually cause.

programme.title: I Tested Brutal Movie Deaths
programme.desc: I tested some of the most brutal movie deaths in real life, including getting hit in the face with a flare, getting stuck in a trash compactor, and having a piano fall on top of me.

programme.title: I Confronted Mack
programme.desc: I finally sat down and asked Mack the questions you guys have been wondering, like what happened to him and whether he'll ever be in another MrBeast video again.

programme.title: I Tested 10,000 Years of Weapons
programme.desc: I tested weapons ranging from 1,000,000 BC all the way to modern artillery, including a tank-destroying cannon, to see if ancient and advanced weapons are truly effective in real scenarios.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Kids Toys
programme.desc: I tested popular kids toys to see if they're actually as dangerous as everyone says they are.

programme.title: 10 Sports You Didn't Know Could Kill You
programme.desc: I teamed up with real athletes to recreate sports impacts on ballistic dummies, testing how dangerous common injuries can be and revealing just how much damage they really cause.

programme.title: I Scientifically Proved Ghosts Are Real (ft. Airrack)
programme.desc: I set up an experiment with Airrack at the historic Bracken Fern Manor to figure out once and for all whether or not ghosts are actually real.

programme.title: I Tested 1000 Years of Punishments
programme.desc: I tested 1000 years of punishments including the guillotine, the garrote, stoning, and the spiked barrel.

programme.title: I Took a Scientist Ghost Hunting
programme.desc: I took real scientists out to a haunted location to see if they could scientifically explain or debunk what happens there.

programme.title: Hidden Cameras You've Walked Past
programme.desc: I bought the craziest hidden cameras on the internet, tested them out, had my friends try to find them, and talked with an expert about how to better protect your privacy.

programme.title: I Investigated a Meteor Crash Site
programme.desc: I traveled to investigate a real meteor crash site to see what evidence of the impact was still left behind.

programme.title: I Tried Extreme Home Security Systems
programme.desc: I built Airrack an extreme home security system, then challenged him and our friends to try and break into his own house.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Weapons From Horror Movies
programme.desc: I recreated deadly weapons from horror movies to see how they would actually perform in real life.

programme.title: I Survived On Japanese Vending Machines
programme.desc: I traveled to Tokyo, Japan and tried a bunch of interesting Japanese vending machines, then stayed overnight in a capsule hotel.

programme.title: I Tested Dangerous Childhood Myths (Again)
programme.desc: I tested crazy things we all did as kids to see how dangerous they really are, like riding a zipline, shooting an arrow straight up, and setting off fireworks.

programme.title: I Lived in a $1,000,000 Off-Road RV
programme.desc: I stayed overnight in a one million dollar off-road RV to see what kind of luxury and capability that much money actually buys you.

programme.title: Overnight In The World's Most Dangerous City
programme.desc: I ventured around the most dangerous city in the world for a full night to see what it's actually like.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Weapons From Every Country
programme.desc: I tested deadly weapons from multiple countries around the world, including UK mortars, an Aztec obsidian sword, and American flamethrowers.

programme.title: I Tested 1000 Years of Torture Devices
programme.desc: I tested crazy torture devices used throughout the last 1000 years to see how brutal and effective they actually were.

programme.desc: I tested 1000 years of weapons from throughout history to see how they hold up and how effective they actually were in real combat.

programme.desc: I spent 48 hours surviving in the wild with nothing but a 3D printer, testing whether it could actually help me build shelter, find food, or start a fire.

programme.title: I Tested Deadly Alarm Clocks
programme.desc: I tested a bunch of dangerous alarm clocks like the ones from MythBusters, including a catapult that throws you out of bed and a rooster that runs from you until you catch it.

programme.title: I Bought the Cheapest First Class Seat
programme.desc: I tried out Delta's first class seat after finding an upgrade for only $250 to see if it was actually worth it.

programme.desc: I bought and tested the strangest, most bizarre alarm clocks I could find to see how effective they actually are at waking you up.

programme.desc: I traveled across Japan to visit some of the most interesting cafes, including one restaurant where the staff literally slaps its customers.

programme.desc: I tested some of the most infamous deadly movie myths from Titanic, Spider-Man, and Indiana Jones to see which ones actually hold up, and which would get you killed in real life.
